customrecordtype.description: Approval matrix cell: Approval Level + Department mapped to a primary and secondary approver. (Level, Department) must be unique. Maintained through the RAX Approval Administration Suitelet; inline editing is disabled so that validation cannot be bypassed.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Approval Requirement
customrecordcustomfield.description: Mandatory. A blank requirement is what allowed bills to auto-approve under the previous build.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Transaction Type
customrecordcustomfield.description: Which transaction type this cell governs. The Approval Level (band) is shared across every transaction type; this is what lets Vendor Bill and Purchase Order route to different approvers for the same band/department. "Both" is not permitted here - create one row per type when the approver is the same for each.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Secondary Approver
customrecordcustomfield.description: May approve interchangeably with the primary. Not a fallback - either person can action the step.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Use Bill Secondary Approver
customrecordcustomfield.description: The employee selected in the Secondary Approver field on the Vendor Bill acts on this cell. With a named primary, the bill selection becomes the co-approver; with no named primary, the bill selection IS the approver.
